summary: This bill requires the Department of Defense to designate a senior official to oversee all programs and activities related to the transition of servicemembers to civilian life or reserve status, and to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of these transition services.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a senior official within the Department of Defense to manage programs for servicemember transition to civilian or reserve status. While it concerns military personnel, it focuses on administrative oversight and support services rather than directly increasing or decreasing military spending on defense operations or procurement. The costs associated would be for personnel and program management, which are minor in the context of overall defense spending.
